_note: Battle formations (trận pháp) and the numbers of command. dmg = damage the squad does, taken = damage it takes, speed = pace of the march; charge applies while a wedge runs at the foe, flank when a blow lands from behind, firstBlow to a foe who has not yet noticed the squad, takenRanged to arrows and stones. mastery 0-100 is trained at the Bãi tập and scales a formation from min to max. cap is the most all tactical factors (arms, formation, tower, surprise, information) may multiply to. info = the factor for the best map level held of the enemy (0..3), infoCounter when level 3 and the right arm is used. A war tent level gives squadLimit squads and cardBase + cardPerLevel * level command cards.

horns.name: Sừng bò
horns.note: Đánh sườn và lưng thêm ×1,25; giữa mỏng.

scatter.name: Rải quân
scatter.note: Giảm 40% thiệt hại từ cung; đánh yếu hơn.

ambush.name: Phục kích
ambush.note: Đòn đầu ×2 vào địch chưa biết; lộ ra thì yếu nhất.
